{{dablink|For other uses of the word "blue," see [[Blue]].}}
The '''''Bluewing''''' is a river boat that operates on the [[River Erinin]]. She is a two-masted vessel.

==History==
In {{ne|979}}, [[Moiraine Damodred]] books passage on the ''Bluewing'' to flee from [[Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|0|14}}
